levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن تميم

notes: «أنه سمع عبد الرحمن بن أيمن يسأل ابن عمر»: the asker is a scene figure, not a link (rule 6); Abu al-Zubayr's hearing is the transmission.
The last link is ابن عمر (second occurrence): «قال ابن عمر فقال النبي» relays his words.
«فقال له» (the answer) has no named speaker in the text; it is read as part of the scene, not as a link.
